# ECN-2026-004 Change notice - Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #2

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P3, line P3-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L1-SB02

Reason for change
- Background: Routine maintenance reviews and field observations identified inconsistent performance of the media containment seals and accelerated wear of rotating elements in Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #2 (EQ-P3-L1-SB02). An evaluation of current lubricants and service records showed the installed lubricant specification did not match the vendor recommendation for this cabinet's bearing assemblies and rotary feed mechanisms as referenced in maintenance history and operator logs.
- Purpose: This change aligns the lubrication specification for EQ-P3-L1-SB02 with the verified part approved for Hot Forge shot blast service to improve reliability, reduce unplanned downtime, and standardize spare stocking for P3, line P3-L1.
- Scope: The change updates the lubricant part number used on EQ-P3-L1-SB02 only. Related procedural adjustments to lubrication verification steps are provided for operator and maintenance teams and will be incorporated into the cited operating procedures.

Affected items
- Equipment impacted: EQ-P3-L1-SB02 (Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #2).
- Parts affected: The lubricant part number currently referenced in local records and maintenance checklists for EQ-P3-L1-SB02 will be replaced by the approved lubricant part number CFW-LUB-278.
- Documents to be updated: SOP-P3-L1-02 and SOP-P3-L1-05 will be revised to reflect the new lubricant specification and the required verification step for incoming lubricant labeling. Maintenance checklist entry and spare parts lists associated with EQ-P3-L1-SB02 will be revised to show CFW-LUB-278. Cite related engineering specification SB-1033 for baseline equipment requirements when confirming compatibility.
- Inventory: Existing stocks currently staged for EQ-P3-L1-SB02 must be quarantined and dispositioned per parts control until they are either reused on other compatible assets or returned to suppliers. Replacement stock orders should reference CFW-LUB-278.

Implementation
- Rationale and approach: Selection of CFW-LUB-278 follows supplier compatibility verification and in-house compatibility testing against media and seal materials used in EQ-P3-L1-SB02. The objective is to ensure lubricant chemistry reduces wear on bearing surfaces and minimizes contaminant interaction with shot media and containment seals.
- Stepwise implementation:
  - Update documentation: Revise SOP-P3-L1-02 and SOP-P3-L1-05 to include CFW-LUB-278 as the approved lubricant for EQ-P3-L1-SB02 and add a verification checkpoint for lubricant lot and label at the point of use. Update SB-1033 references where lubricant compatibility is discussed.
  - Field change: Apply CFW-LUB-278 to lubrication points on EQ-P3-L1-SB02 during the next scheduled maintenance opportunity. Technicians will follow the procedural steps in the revised SOPs for application and verification.
  - Training: Conduct a targeted briefing for P3, line P3-L1 maintenance and operations personnel covering the change, focusing on correct lubricant identification, application location, and contingency steps if unlabeled or suspect lubricant is encountered.
  - Verification: After the first application of CFW-LUB-278, technicians will complete a verification checklist and photographic record of labeled lubricant containers and application points. These verification records will be retained per records requirements below.
- Examples of application context: When servicing the rotary feeder bearings and media conveyor drive bearings on EQ-P3-L1-SB02, technicians will withdraw the labeled container of CFW-LUB-278 and perform the lubrication step specified in SOP-P3-L1-02. If an unlabeled container or a container not marked CFW-LUB-278 is found in the immediate work area, the technician will stop work and notify the maintenance lead for disposition per parts control.
- Contingencies: If an incompatibility is suspected following application, operations will use containment procedures from SB-1033 to isolate the cabinet and initiate joint maintenance–engineering review. Any field findings will be captured in the change record and used to adjust SOP notes as needed.

Records to keep
- Maintain an ECN implementation log that records revision markers and the personnel performing the updated lubrication application on EQ-P3-L1-SB02. Include photographs of lubricant labels showing CFW-LUB-278 at point of use.
- Retain completed verification checklists from SOP-P3-L1-02 and SOP-P3-L1-05 that demonstrate correct lubricant identification and application for each service event post-implementation.
- Log any product returns or quarantine actions for previously stocked lubricant and record final disposition in the spare parts system.
- Archive all related test reports and compatibility assessments referenced during selection of CFW-LUB-278 alongside SB-1033 in the engineering document repository.

Approvals
- Engineering approval: Required to authorize revision of SB-1033 references and confirm compatibility rationale.
- Maintenance approval: Required to authorize field application and update SOP-P3-L1-02 and SOP-P3-L1-05 maintenance steps.
- Operations approval: Required to confirm operator training and update operator checks within SOP-P3-L1-05.
- Approval actions will be documented on the ECN approval log and retained with the ECN record. Sign-off indicates acceptance of CFW-LUB-278 as the approved lubricant for EQ-P3-L1-SB02 and acknowledgment of the required updates to SOP-P3-L1-02, SOP-P3-L1-05, and references to SB-1033.
